text:
Zoe Kim: Hi everyone — Zoe here, starting today on Developer Platform (remote, PST). Quick asks: MDM + company image for MacBook Pro M1, VPN access, SSH to build hosts, and read access to infra repos. Also who is my onboarding buddy? Fun fact: I collect mechanical keyboards and play clarinet.

Eva Li: welcome Zoe!! :tada: People Ops sent the Jamf invite and calendar invites earlier. Check spam if you don't see it. Buddy assignment coming shortly.

Jordan Park: hey Zoe  adding you to #dev-platform and #new-hires-private. For SSH, please generate an ed25519 key and DM me the pubkey. Short commands: ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "zoe@redwood.ai" && cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub

VPN is WireGuard + SSO. The onboarding script is at intra.redwood/infra/wg-onboard. Run it and paste any errors here.

Riley Chen: hi Zoe  I'm your buddy for the next two weeks, happy to walk through repos and CLIs. We usually pair on the first PR. Also we have a small keyboard club channel if you want to join.

InfraBot: Onboarding ticket created for Zoe Kim. Tasks queued: jamf_invite, vpn_profile, ssh_provision, add_to_repos.

Sam Wells: hardware note: company image shipped to the address on file, ETA 48-72h. If you need external monitor or standing desk, file a hw request at intra.redwood/hw.

Priya Rao: welcome again Zoe! I'll schedule a 30m intro with the team this week. If you bring a keyboard pic to the intro, we'll do a mini show-and-tell :keyboard: 

Zoe Kim: Thanks team — I DM'd my pubkey to Jordan and confirmed the Jamf invite. Small question: for SSH to build hosts, do I need a ticket or will Jordan add me after key?

Jordan Park: after I receive the pubkey I'll provision access and you should get an email when it's done. For anything needing elevated perms we'll route via your manager for approval.

Zoe Kim: Perfect, thanks! Looking forward to meeting everyone and sharing keyboard pics.
